title: Inaccurate Beliefs and Cyclical Labor Market Dynamics

detail.title: Inaccurate Beliefs and Cyclical Labor Market Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper examines how systematic biases and heterogeneity in beliefs about the state of the economy shape wage dynamics, labor market flows, and aggregate responses to shocks. I present survey evidence that households form dispersed, backwardlooking expectations about macroeconomic conditions, with more optimistic workers demanding higher wages. Motivated by these findings, I develop a search-and-matching model with sticky wages and endogenous separations where workers and firms face information frictions about the aggregate state of the economy. The model is disciplined using data from the Michigan Survey of Consumers and Survey of Professional Forecasters, targeting key empirical moments. In equilibrium, the gap between firm and worker beliefs drives unemployment volatility, while firm learning raises the persistence of the economy's response to shocks but dampens volatility. Allowing for heterogeneity in workers' learning rates explains observed differences in employment transitions: Workers with more sluggish beliefs remain overly optimistic in recessions, are hired at higher wages, and face a higher risk of separation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究系统性偏见和信念异质性如何影响工资动态、劳动力市场流动和宏观经济冲击响应。基于调查证据，作者开发了一个包含信息摩擦的搜寻匹配模型，发现企业-工人信念差距驱动失业波动，企业学习增加冲击响应的持续性但降低波动性，工人信念异质性解释了就业转换的差异。
AI.research_question: 系统性偏见和信念异质性如何塑造工资动态、劳动力市场流动以及宏观经济对冲击的总体响应？
AI.motivation: 观察到家庭对宏观经济条件形成分散的、后顾性的预期，更乐观的工人要求更高工资，这促使研究信息摩擦如何影响劳动力市场动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜寻匹配模型、粘性工资理论、内生分离模型、信息摩擦理论、异质性信念框架
AI.method: 使用密歇根消费者调查和专业预测者调查数据校准的搜寻匹配模型，包含粘性工资和内生分离，工人和企业面临关于宏观经济状态的信息摩擦。
AI.findings: 1) 企业-工人信念差距驱动失业波动；2) 企业学习增加经济对冲击响应的持续性但降低波动性；3) 信念调整较慢的工人在衰退中保持过度乐观，获得更高工资但面临更高的分离风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将异质性信念和信息摩擦整合到搜寻匹配框架中；2) 解释了信念差距如何驱动劳动力市场动态；3) 为工资粘性和就业转换差异提供了新的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者理解劳动力市场波动提供了新视角；2) 揭示了信息传播和预期管理在稳定就业中的重要性；3) 有助于设计更有效的劳动力市场干预措施。

title: What’s Driving Rising Business Costs?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York - Research Group and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: What’s Driving Rising Business Costs?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: After a period of moderating cost increases, businesses faced mounting cost pressures in 2025. While tariffs played a role in driving up the costs of many inputs—especially among manufacturers—they represent only part of the story. Indeed, firms grappled with substantial cost increases across many categories in the past year. This post is the first in a three-part series analyzing cost and price dynamics among businesses in the New York-Northern New Jersey region based on data collected through our regional business surveys. Firms reported that the sharpest cost increases over the past year were for employee health insurance and utilities, followed by business insurance, and goods and materials inputs. Firms expect cost growth to moderate in 2026. Our second post will examine the sharp increase in employee health insurance costs in more detail and show that such rising costs dampened wage growth for some workers. The third post will analyze firms’ pricing behavior in light of these cost pressures, as well as firms’ inflation expectations.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2025年纽约-北新泽西地区企业面临的成本压力，发现关税只是部分原因，最大的成本增长来自员工健康保险和公用事业费用，其次是商业保险和原材料投入。企业预计2026年成本增长将放缓。
AI.research_question: 2025年纽约-北新泽西地区企业面临的主要成本压力来源是什么？这些成本压力如何影响企业运营和工资增长？
AI.motivation: 在经历了一段成本增长放缓期后，2025年企业面临了显著的成本压力。虽然关税是重要因素，但需要全面了解企业面临的各种成本压力来源及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本压力分析框架、企业成本结构理论、通货膨胀预期理论、工资-成本权衡理论
AI.method: 基于纽约联邦储备银行区域商业调查数据的实证分析，采用调查数据收集方法，对纽约-北新泽西地区企业进行成本动态分析
AI.findings:
1. 过去一年最显著的成本增长是员工健康保险和公用事业费用
2. 其次是商业保险、商品和原材料投入
3. 关税虽然推动了制造业成本上升，但只是整体成本压力的一部分
4. 企业预计2026年成本增长将放缓
5. 健康保险成本上升抑制了部分工人的工资增长
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了企业成本压力的多维度分析框架
2. 揭示了健康保险成本与工资增长之间的权衡关系
3. 扩展了关税影响研究的视角，强调其他成本因素的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业管理者提供了成本管理的参考依据
2. 为政策制定者了解企业成本结构提供了实证数据
3. 帮助企业和政策制定者预测未来成本趋势
4. 为工资谈判和福利政策设计提供了参考

title: Electric Vehicles as Power Storage: Substitutes or Complements to Renewables?
affiliations: and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Electric Vehicles as Power Storage: Substitutes or Complements to Renewables?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have influenced their study or could have any material interests in the findings of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not relevant
declarations.funderStatement: This reserach have recieved funding from the Research Council of Norway

detail.abstract: Using electric vehicles (EVs) as power storage is referred to as vehicleto-grid (V2G). With V2G, the EV may serve two needs: transportation and when parked, electricity market stabilization, which will become increasingly important as the share of intermittent renewable power in the power mix grows. To our knowledge no study has yet analyzed how V2G interacts with intermittent renewables. In this paper we ask: i) Do V2G and intermittent renewables mutually benefit each other, and if so: ii) Should V2G be subsidized? We show analytically that increasing the share of EV owners with V2G lowers the expected price of electricity. Nevertheless, investments in renewable energy are spurred as their production weighted price increases. Electricity consumers with inelastic demand will be better off, while baseload and price-responsive electricity producers will tend to be worse off with V2G. Moreover, we show that the laissez faire market uptake of V2G is efficient, and hence no subsidies are warranted. Finally, we calibrate the model to the German electricity market in 2035 and provide some illustrative, quantitative results. Among others we find that socially efficient adoption of V2G will increase electricity production from renewables by nearly 2 percent due to higher investments. Results also indicate that there could be a positive terms of trade effect for Germany of V2G implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析车辆到电网（V2G）技术与间歇性可再生能源的相互作用，发现V2G能降低电价预期但提高可再生能源投资，市场自发采用V2G是有效的，无需补贴。
AI.research_question: V2G与间歇性可再生能源是否相互促进？V2G是否需要补贴？
AI.motivation: 随着间歇性可再生能源在电力结构中的比重增加，电力市场稳定变得日益重要。电动汽车作为储能设备（V2G）可同时满足交通和电力市场稳定需求，但尚无研究分析V2G与间歇性可再生能源的相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力市场经济学、可再生能源投资理论、V2G技术经济学、市场效率理论
AI.method: 理论分析模型结合德国电力市场2035年情景校准，提供定量结果
AI.findings: 1. V2G普及降低电价预期但提高可再生能源投资；2. 需求弹性小的消费者受益，基荷和价格响应型发电商受损；3. 市场自发采用V2G是有效的，无需补贴；4. 德国2035年情景显示V2G可使可再生能源发电增加近2%，并可能产生正贸易条件效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析V2G与间歇性可再生能源的相互作用机制，证明市场自发采用V2G的效率性，为V2G政策制定提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供V2G无需补贴的依据，帮助电力市场参与者理解V2G对市场结构的影响，为德国等国家制定V2G和可再生能源协同发展策略提供参考。

title: Are Rising Employee Health Insurance Costs Dampening Wage Growth?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York - Research Group and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Are Rising Employee Health Insurance Costs Dampening Wage Growth?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Employer-sponsored health insurance represents a substantial component of total compensation paid by firms to many workers in the United States. Such costs have climbed by close to 20 percent over the past five years. Indeed, the average annual premium for employer-sponsored family health insurance coverage was about $27,000 in 2025—roughly equivalent to the wage of a full-time worker paid $15 per hour. Our February regional business surveys asked firms whether their wage setting decisions were influenced by the rising cost of employee health insurance. As we showed in our companion post, respondents reported an average increase in such costs of more than 13 percent this year. Businesses providing insurance to their workers indicated that absent these cost increases, they would have raised wages by roughly an additional percentage point, on average, suggesting that rising health insurance costs resulted in a drag on wage growth for workers at these firms.
To view post:https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/03/are-rising-employee-health-insurance-costs-dampening-wage-growth/

AI.tldr: 研究发现，美国雇主赞助的健康保险成本上升对工资增长产生了抑制作用。企业调查显示，健康保险成本平均上涨13%以上，如果没有这些成本增加，企业会将工资额外提高约1个百分点。
AI.research_question: 员工健康保险成本上升是否抑制了工资增长？
AI.motivation: 雇主赞助的健康保险在美国是员工总薪酬的重要组成部分，过去五年成本上涨近20%，2025年平均家庭保险保费达27,000美元，相当于每小时15美元的全职员工工资。这种成本上升可能影响企业的工资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于薪酬补偿理论，企业面临总薪酬预算约束，当非工资福利成本（如健康保险）上升时，可能挤压工资增长空间。
AI.method: 使用纽约联储的区域商业调查数据，询问企业工资设定决策是否受到员工健康保险成本上升的影响，并进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 企业报告健康保险成本平均上涨超过13%，提供保险的企业表示，如果没有这些成本增加，他们会将工资额外提高约1个百分点，表明健康保险成本上升抑制了工资增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 为薪酬补偿理论提供了实证支持，验证了非工资福利成本上升对工资增长的挤出效应，丰富了企业薪酬决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者理解健康保险成本上升对工资增长的负面影响，为企业薪酬规划提供参考，有助于评估医疗成本控制政策的经济效应。

title: Transfer Price Documentation Rules and Multinational Firm Behavior - Evidence from France
affiliations: German Institute of Development and Sustainability (IDOS), University of Muenster, University of Mannheim, University of Duisburg-Essen, University of Mannheim and ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research

detail.title: Transfer Price Documentation Rules and Multinational Firm Behavior - Evidence from France

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-007
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 225
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In recent years, a growing number of countries have enacted tax rules that require multinational enterprises (MNEs) to document their intra-firm trade prices and show that they are set as in third-party trade. The objective of these rules is to limit opportunities for strategic trade mis-pricing and profit shifting to lower-tax affiliates. In this paper, we study the regulations' fiscal and real effects. Testing ground is the introduction of transfer pricing (TP) documentation rules in France in 2010. Drawing on rich firm-level data, we show that affected MNEs reduced their outward profit shifting from France, while simultaneously lowering real investments in the country. Outside of France, treated MNEs decreased their real economic activity at low-tax (but not at high-tax) group locations.

AI.tldr: 法国2010年引入转让定价文档规则后，受影响的跨国企业减少了从法国的利润转移，但同时也降低了在法国的实际投资。在法国境外，这些企业减少了在低税率（而非高税率）地区的经济活动。
AI.research_question: 转让定价文档规则对跨国企业的财政效应（利润转移）和实际效应（投资决策）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的国家实施转让定价文档规则以限制跨国企业通过战略性的贸易定价不当和利润转移来避税，但这些规则的实际经济影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转让定价理论、利润转移理论、税收遵从成本理论、跨国公司投资决策理论
AI.method: 利用法国2010年引入转让定价文档规则的准自然实验，使用丰富的企业层面数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 受影响的跨国企业减少了从法国的利润转移；2. 同时降低了在法国的实际投资；3. 在法国境外，减少了在低税率（而非高税率）地区的经济活动
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了转让定价规则的双重效应（财政效应和实际效应）；2. 提供了税收遵从成本如何影响跨国公司全球投资决策的证据；3. 丰富了关于税收政策非预期后果的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了转让定价规则实施效果的实证证据；2. 揭示了税收政策可能产生的投资抑制效应；3. 为跨国企业应对转让定价合规要求提供了参考

title: Firms’ Inflation Expectations Return to 2024 Levels
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York - Research Group and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Firms’ Inflation Expectations Return to 2024 Levels

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Businesses experienced substantial cost pressures in 2025 as the cost of insurance and utilities rose sharply, while an increase in tariffs contributed to rising goods and materials costs. This post examines how firms in the New York-Northern New Jersey region adjusted their prices in response to these cost pressures and describes their expectations for future price increases and inflation. Survey results show an acceleration in firms’ price increases in 2025, with an especially sharp increase in the manufacturing sector. While both cost and price increases intensified last year, our surveys reveal that these do not contribute to firms believing that inflation will be on the rise in the short or longer term. In fact, firms’ inflation expectations have moderated compared to what was expected a year ago. Firms now anticipate inflation of 3 percent in the year ahead, lower than what was expected last year at this time. Importantly, like last year, longer-term inflation expectations also remain well anchored.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/03/firms-inflation-expectations-return-to-2024-levels/

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2025年纽约-北新泽西地区企业在面临保险、公用事业成本上升和关税增加的压力下，如何调整价格以及他们对未来通胀的预期。研究发现，尽管企业成本上升导致价格加速上涨，但企业的通胀预期反而有所缓和，短期和长期通胀预期都保持在较低水平。
AI.research_question: 企业在面临成本压力时如何调整价格？他们的通胀预期如何变化？
AI.motivation: 2025年企业面临显著的成本压力，包括保险和公用事业成本急剧上升，以及关税增加导致的商品和材料成本上涨。了解企业如何应对这些成本压力以及他们的通胀预期变化，对于理解通胀动态和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本推动型通胀理论、企业定价行为理论、通胀预期形成机制、适应性预期与理性预期理论。
AI.method: 基于纽约联邦储备银行对纽约-北新泽西地区企业的调查数据，分析企业在2025年的价格调整行为和通胀预期变化。
AI.findings: 1. 2025年企业价格加速上涨，制造业尤其明显；2. 尽管成本和价格都在上涨，但企业并不认为通胀会在短期或长期内上升；3. 企业的通胀预期相比一年前有所缓和，预计未来一年通胀率为3%；4. 长期通胀预期保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了成本压力下企业定价行为与通胀预期的脱钩现象；2. 提供了通胀预期锚定机制的经验证据；3. 丰富了企业通胀预期形成理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了企业层面通胀动态的实时监测数据；2. 有助于央行更好地理解通胀预期的形成机制；3. 为企业决策者提供了行业定价行为的参考信息。

title: Outsourcing Harm: Global Labor, Economic Violence, and Invisible Human Cost

detail.title: Outsourcing Harm: Global Labor, Economic Violence, and Invisible Human Cost

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or professional relationships with any individuals, organizations, or institutions that could be perceived to have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve original empirical research with human participants, clinical subjects, or private personal data. It is based on publicly available sources, legal documents, historical records, and scholarly literature. As such, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any public, private, or nonprofit funding bodies.

detail.abstract: This paper examines global labor outsourcing as a contemporary form of economic violence through which harm is externalized, obscured, and rendered morally distant. It argues that in 2025, the United States and other advanced democracies increasingly sustain domestic prosperity by exporting precarity, exploitation, and environmental harm through global supply chains that fragment responsibility while preserving legality. Drawing on international human rights law, global political economy, and moral philosophy, the analysis shows how legal neutrality, corporate impunity, and voluntary compliance regimes enable states and consumers to benefit from injustice without direct coercion or visible wrongdoing. Workers in the Global South-particularly women, children, and migrant laborers-are governed as expendable populations whose suffering is normalized through distance, abstraction, and market logic. By treating global labor systems as sites of governance rather than neutral markets, the paper contends that outsourcing functions as a moral technology that reallocates risk downward and outward, allowing democracies to evade ethical responsibility. It concludes that injustice cannot be exported without consequence: when prosperity depends on invisible harm, democratic legitimacy itself is placed at risk. Publication Note This paper is part of an independent research series examining moral drift, structural violence, and ethical failure in contemporary governance and global political economy. Extending earlier analyses of war, discrimination, and domestic social sorting, it shifts the focus beyond national borders to examine how harm is externalized through global labor systems and supply chains. Adopting an international, non-U.S. perspective grounded in human rights and moral philosophy, the paper treats outsourcing not as a neutral market process but as a moral and political structure that redistributes risk, suffering, and disposability across populations. The paper functions both as a standalone scholarly contribution and as a sequential chapter within a larger book-length manuscript on power and moral responsibility in 2025.

AI.tldr: 该论文将全球劳动力外包视为一种当代经济暴力形式，通过这种形式，伤害被外部化、模糊化并产生道德距离。文章认为，2025年，美国和其他发达民主国家通过全球供应链输出不稳定、剥削和环境危害来维持国内繁荣，同时分散责任并保持合法性。
AI.research_question: 全球劳动力外包如何作为一种经济暴力形式运作，使发达民主国家能够将伤害外部化，同时维持国内繁荣并规避道德责任？
AI.motivation: 研究当代治理和全球经济中道德漂移、结构性暴力和伦理失败的问题。将关注点从国家边界扩展到全球劳动力系统和供应链，探讨伤害如何通过这些系统被外部化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人权法、全球政治经济学、道德哲学。将全球劳动力系统视为治理场所而非中性市场。
AI.method: 理论分析，基于国际人权法、全球政治经济学和道德哲学的理论框架，采用非美国的国际视角。
AI.findings: 法律中立性、企业有罪不罚和自愿合规制度使国家和消费者能够从不公正中获益，而无需直接胁迫或可见的过错。全球南方的工人（特别是妇女、儿童和移民劳工）被视为可消耗的人口，其痛苦通过距离、抽象和市场逻辑被正常化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将外包概念化为一种道德技术，而非中性市场过程；提出全球劳动力系统作为治理场所的理论框架；发展了关于道德距离和结构性暴力的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了民主国家如何通过全球供应链规避道德责任；为政策制定者、企业和消费者提供了伦理反思的基础；指出了当繁荣依赖于看不见的伤害时，民主合法性本身面临风险。

title: Financial Markets can explain Exchange Rates
affiliations: University of Oslo and Department of Financial Economics, BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Financial Markets can explain Exchange Rates

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding sources

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces two simple modifications to the standard two-country open macroeconomic model with nominal bonds traded internationally: (i) both country-specific and global asset markets are incomplete, and (ii) acquiring foreign assets involves a transaction cost. We show that these departures from the benchmark model are sufficient to address the challenge posed by Lustig and Verdelhan (2019), who highlight three empirical facts about exchange rates-high volatility (standard deviation of 11%), a sizable currency risk premium, and near-zero cyclicality-and argue that the standard model fails to match them. Moreover, reconciling the high equity Sharpe ratio with a volatile stochastic discount factor (SDF) is also difficult in the baseline framework. 
We further relate our results to Chernov et al. (2023), who propose the need for international arbitrageurs to account for exchange rate dynamics, emphasizing that a large portion of exchange rate variation is unspanned by financial markets. In contrast, our model-with a simple asset structure and no international arbitrageurs-can account for the key empirical features they emphasize. 
Modest deviations from standard assumptions can go a long way in accounting for exchange rate behavior. This suggests that even simple financial market frictions can significantly enhance our understanding of exchange rates-perhaps more than previously believed by some.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个简单修改（不完全资产市场和交易成本）解决了标准两国开放宏观经济模型在解释汇率高波动性、货币风险溢价和低周期性方面的困难，同时也能解释高股权夏普比率与波动随机贴现因子的矛盾。
AI.research_question: 如何通过简单的金融市场摩擦（不完全资产市场和交易成本）来改进标准两国开放宏观经济模型，使其能够解释汇率的高波动性、货币风险溢价、低周期性以及股权夏普比率与随机贴现因子的关系？
AI.motivation: 标准的两国开放宏观经济模型无法解释Lustig和Verdelhan（2019）强调的三个汇率经验事实：高波动性（标准差11%）、显著的货币风险溢价和接近零的周期性。同时，基准框架也难以调和高股权夏普比率与波动随机贴现因子的矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两国开放宏观经济模型，引入两个关键修改：1）国家和全球资产市场都不完全；2）获取外国资产涉及交易成本。这些偏离标准假设的修改构成了理论框架的核心。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过修改标准两国开放宏观经济模型的假设条件，构建包含不完全资产市场和交易成本的新模型，然后分析该模型能否匹配汇率的关键经验特征。
AI.findings: 1）不完全资产市场和交易成本这两个简单修改足以解释汇率的高波动性、货币风险溢价和低周期性；2）该模型也能解释高股权夏普比率与波动随机贴现因子的关系；3）与Chernov等人（2023）需要国际套利者的复杂模型不同，本文的简单模型就能解释汇率动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）证明了简单的金融市场摩擦（不完全资产市场和交易成本）足以解决标准模型在解释汇率特征方面的困难；2）提供了更简约的理论框架，无需引入复杂的国际套利者假设；3）挑战了需要复杂机制才能解释汇率动态的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了更实用的汇率分析框架；2）表明相对简单的模型改进就能显著提高对汇率行为的理解；3）为金融市场参与者理解汇率风险提供了更易操作的模型基础。

title: Impact of COVID-19 on the Mongolian Mining Sector
affiliations: Queen's University Belfast, , National University of Mongolia - Economic Research Institute and Economic Research Institute

detail.title: Impact of COVID-19 on the Mongolian Mining Sector

declarations.funderStatement: This research was commissioned by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA). The views expressed in this paper are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the views of JICA.

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic had devastating global and domestic economic and health impacts. While these effects are broadly understood, the impact of COVID-19 on the Mongolian mining sector, a key economic sector, remains unclear. This study seeks to bridge this knowledge gap by analyzing relevant secondary data, conducting a survey of mining companies, and simulating near-term economic outlooks using a recursive dynamic CGE model. The study concluded that the slowdown of the Mongolian mining sector was a driving force behind the overall economic slowdown during the COVID-19 pandemic. The mining sector was affected by various external and internal shocks, including fluctuations in Chinese demand, price shocks, and COVID-19 related government restrictions. Most surveyed mining companies reported decreases in both sales and production, coupled with numerous labor, production, and transportation issues arising from COVID-19 related restrictions. While differences existed across commodities, most mining companies were optimistic about future recovery. Given the study's finding that the post-COVID-19 economic recovery will be closely linked to the mining sector's recovery, we simulated 3 alternative mining-sector recovery scenarios using an in-house CGE model. Overall, the simulation results highlighted the detrimental economic effect of continued pandemic conditions and the need to diversify the Mongolian economy beyond mining. In light of these findings, the government must balance the consequences of COVID-19-related measures for the mining sector with the need to contain the pandemic.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了COVID-19对蒙古采矿业的冲击，发现采矿业放缓是蒙古整体经济放缓的主要驱动力。研究通过调查和CGE模型模拟，指出经济复苏与采矿业恢复密切相关，并建议政府平衡防疫措施与采矿业发展，同时推动经济多元化。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情对蒙古采矿业（关键经济部门）的具体影响是什么？这种影响如何传导至整体经济？
AI.motivation: 虽然COVID-19的全球影响已被广泛了解，但对蒙古采矿业这一关键经济部门的具体影响仍不清楚。采矿业对蒙古经济至关重要，了解其受疫情影响的程度对制定经济复苏政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于宏观经济冲击理论、产业经济学和资源依赖理论，特别是外部冲击对资源型经济体的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1）分析相关二手数据；2）对采矿公司进行问卷调查；3）使用递归动态CGE模型模拟近期经济前景和三种替代性采矿业复苏情景。
AI.findings: 1）采矿业放缓是蒙古整体经济放缓的主要驱动力；2）采矿业受到中国需求波动、价格冲击和COVID-19政府限制等多重冲击；3）大多数采矿公司报告销售和生产下降，并面临劳动力、生产和运输问题；4）尽管存在商品差异，多数公司对未来复苏持乐观态度；5）经济复苏与采矿业恢复密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化了对资源依赖型经济体在外部冲击下脆弱性的理解；2）提供了疫情冲击对采矿业影响的具体机制分析；3）扩展了CGE模型在资源型经济危机应对研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政府平衡防疫措施与采矿业发展提供决策依据；2）通过三种复苏情景模拟为政策制定提供参考；3）强调蒙古经济需要超越采矿业的多元化发展；4）为类似资源依赖型经济体应对疫情冲击提供借鉴。

title: School Clustering and Religious Competition: Persistence of Educational Inequality in Colonial and Post-colonial D.R. Congo
affiliations: , University of Namur - Centre de Recherche en Economie du Developpement (CRED) and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: School Clustering and Religious Competition: Persistence of Educational Inequality in Colonial and Post-colonial D.R. Congo
detail.abstract: This paper examines the persistence of educational inequalities in Africa, focusing on colonial and contemporary Congo. By analyzing historical and contemporary surveys, archives, and school administrative data, we document the continuing impact of colonial-era factors and explore mechanisms of path dependency. We find that contemporary educational inequalities are driven by the clustering of postindependence schools around historical Christian missions. This clustering dynamic has increased over time and is shaped by religious competition between schools of different denominations. This spatial pattern significantly affects girls' education more than boys' because girls are more sensitive to distance barriers, explaining a stronger colonial legacy for female education. Our analysis suggests that parental education and missions as agents of structural change have limited influence on regional educational outcomes in this context.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析刚果的历史和当代数据，发现教育不平等持续存在，主要原因是后独立时期的学校集中在历史基督教传教点周围，这种空间模式对女孩教育影响更大，因为女孩对距离障碍更敏感。
AI.research_question: 非洲教育不平等为何持续存在？殖民时期的因素如何通过路径依赖机制影响当代教育不平等？
AI.motivation: 理解非洲教育不平等的持久性，特别是殖民历史如何通过空间和制度机制影响当代教育机会分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径依赖理论、空间不平等理论、殖民遗产理论、宗教竞争理论
AI.method: 分析历史与当代调查数据、档案资料和学校行政数据，采用混合方法研究
AI.findings: 1. 当代教育不平等主要由后独立时期学校围绕历史基督教传教点聚集造成；2. 这种聚集动态随时间增强，受不同教派学校间宗教竞争影响；3. 空间模式对女孩教育影响更大，因为女孩对距离障碍更敏感；4. 父母教育和传教作为结构变革代理的影响有限
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了路径依赖理论在教育不平等研究中的应用；2. 揭示了宗教竞争如何塑造教育空间分布；3. 提供了性别差异在殖民遗产影响中的机制解释
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供针对性干预建议，特别是关注女孩教育的地理障碍；2. 指出单纯增加父母教育或依赖传教机构不足以解决区域教育不平等；3. 强调需要打破历史形成的学校空间聚集模式

title: Irreversible Investment with Endogenous Scale under Kinked Subsidy Schedules
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and University of Macedonia - Department of Economics

detail.title: Irreversible Investment with Endogenous Scale under Kinked Subsidy Schedules

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 07/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study an irreversible investment problem with endogenous scale under uncertainty, characterized by a concave subsidy schedule featuring a policy-induced kink. Using a real options framework, we analyze how the structure of policy support, in particular, the presence of threshold-induced kinks, reshapes optimal investment timing and scale. Motivated by the recent reform of the Common Agricultural Policy, which introduced redistributive payments linked to "first hectares", we show that nonsmooth support schemes fundamentally alter investment incentives. Smaller projects respond to higher subsidies by expanding investment scale without affecting timing, while larger projects exhibit non-monotonic responses: higher basic payments encourage expansion but delay investment, whereas stronger redistributive components induce earlier investment in smaller projects. These asymmetric responses generate a pooling effect around the policy threshold, whereby heterogeneous investors optimally converge to similar project sizes. By introducing policy-induced kinks into a real options model with endogenous scale, the analysis shows that redistributive subsidies can generate pooling and non-monotonic timing-scale responses that cannot arise under smooth or linear payoff structures. More generally, the results highlight how non-linear subsidies affect irreversible investment decisions, with implications for subsidy capitalization and the dynamic allocation of land.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有内生规模的不确定性下不可逆投资问题，分析带有政策诱导拐点的凹性补贴计划如何影响最优投资时机和规模。基于实物期权框架，研究发现非线性补贴方案会改变投资激励：小型项目通过扩大规模响应更高补贴而不影响时机，大型项目则呈现非单调响应。政策阈值导致异质投资者在相似项目规模上聚集。
AI.research_question: 政策支持结构（特别是阈值诱导的拐点）如何重塑最优投资时机和规模？非线性补贴方案如何影响不可逆投资决策？
AI.motivation: 受欧盟共同农业政策改革（引入与"首公顷"挂钩的再分配支付）的启发，研究非平滑支持方案如何根本改变投资激励，以及政策诱导的拐点如何影响投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权框架，结合内生规模选择的不可逆投资理论，引入政策诱导的拐点（非平滑支付结构）分析非线性补贴的影响。
AI.method: 采用实物期权模型，分析具有内生规模选择的不可逆投资问题，特别关注凹性补贴计划中的政策诱导拐点，通过理论建模和数值分析研究投资时机和规模的优化决策。
AI.findings: 1) 小型项目对更高补贴的响应是扩大投资规模而不影响时机；2) 大型项目呈现非单调响应：更高的基本支付鼓励扩张但延迟投资，而更强的再分配成分促使更早投资于较小项目；3) 不对称响应在政策阈值周围产生聚集效应，异质投资者最优地收敛到相似的项目规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政策诱导的拐点引入具有内生规模的实物期权模型，展示再分配补贴可以产生在平滑或线性支付结构下不会出现的聚集和非单调时机-规模响应，扩展了非线性补贴对不可逆投资决策影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计补贴方案提供洞见：非线性补贴会影响投资时机和规模的动态分配，政策阈值可能导致投资者在特定规模上聚集，影响补贴资本化和土地动态配置，对农业政策改革等实际应用有重要启示。

title:
The Political Dysfunction Tax
A Forensic Audit of Global Governance Efficiency

detail.title:
The Political Dysfunction Tax
A Forensic Audit of Global Governance Efficiency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The author does have a vested interest in not losing $97 trillion per year, but shares this interest with most of the species.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human subjects. Operating governments at 31-53% efficiency while charging full price does, however, involve all of them.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding. At a 31-53% governance efficiency rate, the author considers this par for the course.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute for Accelerated Medicine (2025). DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18603840. URL: https://political-dysfunction-tax.warondisease.org

detail.abstract:
This report introduces the Political Dysfunction Tax (T_pd): the implicit levy paid to
entropy through governance inefficiency. By constructing a Waste Ledger (military overspend,
administrative friction, incarceration costs) and an Opportunity Ledger (suppressed health
innovation, migration restrictions, lead poisoning), we calculate a Global Governance Efficiency
Score of 31-53%. Current governance destroys $97 trillion annually in unrealized potential,
including $34T from delayed cures, $57T from migration restrictions, and $6T from lead exposure,
suggesting civilization operates far below its technological possibilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"政治功能障碍税"概念，通过构建浪费账本和机会账本，量化全球治理效率损失，发现当前治理体系每年造成97万亿美元潜在价值损失，治理效率仅为31-53%。
AI.research_question: 如何量化全球治理体系中的效率损失？当前治理体系造成的经济和社会成本有多大？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对治理效率损失的系统性量化分析，无法准确评估政治功能障碍对经济社会发展的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治功能障碍税理论、熵增理论、治理效率评估框架、机会成本分析
AI.method: 构建双重账本系统：浪费账本（军事超支、行政摩擦、监禁成本）和机会账本（被抑制的健康创新、移民限制、铅中毒影响），计算全球治理效率得分
AI.findings: 全球治理效率得分仅为31-53%，每年造成97万亿美元潜在损失，其中：延迟治疗损失34万亿美元，移民限制损失57万亿美元，铅暴露损失6万亿美元
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了政治功能障碍税的理论框架，建立了治理效率的量化评估方法，为治理研究提供了新的分析工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了治理效率改进的具体方向，揭示了治理改革的经济价值，为资源优化配置提供了实证依据

title: Does China's Intellectual Property Pilot and Demonstration City influence firm's innovation performance?
affiliations: University of Leeds - Faculty of Business, University of Leeds - Faculty of Business and Leeds University Business School (LUBS) - Division of Economics

detail.title: Does China's Intellectual Property Pilot and Demonstration City influence firm's innovation performance?
detail.abstract: National innovation policies are designed to stimulate firm-level innovation; however, their micro-level impacts and underlying mechanisms differ across countries. This paper examines the impacts of China's Intellectual Property Pilot and Demonstration City (IPPDC) policy on firms' patenting behaviour, using unique handpicked firm-level patent and R&D data from 2008 to 2022. Employing a multi-period difference-indifference estimator (CSDID) on a propensityscore-matched sample of Chinese manufacturing firms, we find that the IPPDC policy program significantly enhances firm-level innovation, primarily through increased city-level investments in science, technology, and education, which in turn stimulate corporate R&D expenditure. Significant heterogeneity exists in different subgroups: positive impacts are pronounced among large firms, but for small firms, the effects are negative; firms in less competitive markets are more likely to increase innovation, and firms without separation of management and ownership are more likely to promote innovation activities. Regional differences also emerge with coastal firms only prioritising technological innovation, while inland firms also focus on non-technological patents. Our findings remain robust across various checks and reveal that the policy delivers both immediate and sustained long-term effects, underscoring its success in fostering innovation.

AI.tldr: 中国知识产权试点示范城市政策通过增加城市科技教育投资促进企业研发支出，显著提升企业创新水平，但效果存在异质性：大型企业受益明显，小型企业效果为负；市场竞争程度低的企业更易增加创新；两权合一企业更易促进创新活动；沿海企业侧重技术创新，内陆企业兼顾非技术创新。
AI.research_question: 中国知识产权试点示范城市政策如何影响企业专利行为？政策效果在不同企业类型、市场环境和地区间存在怎样的异质性？
AI.motivation: 国家创新政策旨在促进企业创新，但其微观影响和机制在不同国家存在差异。需要深入理解中国知识产权试点示范城市政策对企业创新行为的具体影响机制和异质性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新政策理论、知识产权制度理论、企业创新理论、资源基础观、制度理论
AI.method: 使用2008-2022年手工收集的企业层面专利和研发数据，采用多期双重差分法（CSDID）对倾向得分匹配后的中国制造业企业样本进行分析
AI.findings: IPPDC政策显著提升企业创新，主要通过增加城市科技教育投资刺激企业研发支出；大型企业效果为正而小型企业为负；市场竞争程度低的企业更易增加创新；两权合一企业更易促进创新；沿海企业侧重技术创新，内陆企业兼顾非技术创新；政策具有即时和持续长期效应

title: "Unmatched" from Skewed Births to a Structural Surplus of Grooms
affiliations: and Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics

detail.title: "Unmatched" from Skewed Births to a Structural Surplus of Grooms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: na
declarations.ethicsApproval: na
declarations.funderStatement: na

detail.abstract: Data on marriage flows are not available in most developing countries, making marriage market imbalance difficult to measure. Existing measures use crude fertility rates and do not account for early-life mortality, overstating the number of births surviving to marriageable ages. This paper develops the Surplus Groom Index to quantify marriage market imbalance under monogamy using census age structure, vital registration of births and deaths, and marriage timing data. The index incorporates effective fertility-total births adjusted for under-five mortality-to reflect actual cohort progression from birth to marriageable ages. This adjustment matters in settings where child mortality shapes the supply of marriage partners. Using India's 2011 Census data, we find that eleven percent of men aged 15-54 cannot marry due to bride shortage, approximately 39 million men. Marriage imbalance is widespread rather than regionally concentrated. Punjab records the highest deficit at 33 percent, but states considered demographically progressive show substantial imbalance: Kerala 18 percent, West Bengal 14 percent, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu 11 percent each. Declining fertility has produced smaller female cohorts unable to absorb male-heavy cohorts from earlier birth years. Balanced sex ratios at birth do not ensure marriage market equilibrium once fertility declines and marriage is delayed.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了"过剩新郎指数"来衡量一夫一妻制下的婚姻市场失衡，使用人口普查年龄结构、出生死亡登记和婚姻时间数据，考虑了儿童死亡率对适婚年龄人口供给的影响。在印度2011年人口普查数据中，发现11%的15-54岁男性因新娘短缺无法结婚，约3900万人。
AI.research_question: 如何准确衡量发展中国家婚姻市场失衡问题？如何量化一夫一妻制下因新娘短缺导致无法结婚的男性比例？
AI.motivation: 大多数发展中国家缺乏婚姻流动数据，现有衡量方法使用粗出生率且未考虑儿童早期死亡率，高估了存活到适婚年龄的人口数量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婚姻市场失衡理论，人口统计学中的队列分析方法，考虑儿童死亡率对适婚年龄人口供给的影响。
AI.method: 开发"过剩新郎指数"，使用人口普查年龄结构数据、出生死亡登记数据、婚姻时间数据，结合有效生育率（考虑5岁以下死亡率调整的总出生数）。
AI.findings: 印度11%的15-54岁男性（约3900万人）因新娘短缺无法结婚；婚姻失衡普遍存在而非地区集中；旁遮普邦赤字最高达33%，但喀拉拉邦（18%）、西孟加拉邦（14%）、卡纳塔克邦和泰米尔纳德邦（各11%）等被认为人口结构进步的邦也显示显著失衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑儿童死亡率的婚姻市场失衡衡量新方法；证明了生育率下降和婚姻延迟如何导致婚姻市场失衡，即使出生性别比平衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化婚姻市场失衡的工具；揭示了印度婚姻失衡的普遍性和严重程度；强调了在生育率下降背景下考虑儿童死亡率的重要性。

title: Mixed-Data Sampling under Extreme Frequency Mismatch: Inference on Within-Period Information
affiliations: Beijing Normal-Hong Kong Baptist University, Purdue University and Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics

detail.title: Mixed-Data Sampling under Extreme Frequency Mismatch: Inference on Within-Period Information
detail.abstract: Unrestricted mixed-data sampling (U-MIDAS) models are widely used to incorporate high-frequency data into forecasts of low-frequency macroeconomic outcomes, but they often become unstable when the frequency mismatch is large. Using a continuous-time embedding, we show that under extreme frequency mismatch, U-MIDAS attempts to recover more information than the data can support, leading to an ill-posed inverse problem for the lag-weight function. We propose smoothing-spline regularization as a practical solution that stabilizes estimation and allows researchers to make interpretable statements about when high-frequency information matters within a period-for example, through cumulative and late-quarter effects. A Bayesian implementation provides transparent uncertainty quantification for these timing summaries. Simulations and applications to US GDP nowcasting and macroeconomic uncertainty measurement show that the approach delivers stable estimates and economically meaningful inference in settings with dense high-frequency data. Overall, our results justify inference on economically interpretable within-period timing measures even when pointwise lag estimates are unreliable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用平滑样条正则化方法解决U-MIDAS模型在极端频率不匹配时的不稳定性问题，通过连续时间嵌入证明问题本质是病态逆问题，并提供可解释的时序分析工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在极端频率不匹配情况下稳定U-MIDAS模型估计，并实现对高频数据在低频周期内时序影响的可解释性分析？
AI.motivation: U-MIDAS模型在将高频数据纳入低频宏观经济预测时，当频率差异过大时变得不稳定，限制了其在实际应用中的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于连续时间嵌入理论框架，证明极端频率不匹配时U-MIDAS模型试图恢复超出数据支持的信息，形成滞后权重函数的病态逆问题。
AI.method: 提出平滑样条正则化方法稳定估计，采用贝叶斯实现提供不确定性量化，通过模拟研究和美国GDP即时预测及宏观经济不确定性测量的应用验证方法。
AI.findings: 平滑样条正则化方法在密集高频数据环境下提供稳定估计和经济上有意义的推断，即使点状滞后估计不可靠时，仍能支持对经济可解释的周期内时序度量的推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 识别U-MIDAS模型不稳定性的理论根源；2) 提出正则化解决方案的理论基础；3) 提供周期内时序影响的可解释性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1) 提供稳定U-MIDAS估计的实用工具；2) 支持累积效应和季度末效应等经济可解释时序分析；3) 为GDP即时预测和不确定性测量提供改进方法。

title: The Shapley Value of Equity Analysts

detail.title: The Shapley Value of Equity Analysts
detail.abstract: This study develops a Shapley value-inspired analyst-specific measure to identify sellside analysts whose individual forecasts add more incremental value to the aggregate-level consensus forecast. I aggregate the marginal contributions of analysts to the consensus accuracy of firms in their coverage portfolio to obtain the value-added measure. Contrarian analysts with larger absolute forecast errors and larger deviations from consensus have greater incremental impact on consensus accuracy. In contrast, all-star analysts and analysts at larger brokerages add lower incremental value at the aggregate level. Timing of forecasts (either very timely or late) and job experience also positively affect forecast deviation and value-added. Overall, these findings demonstrate that contrarian analysts improve information aggregation despite their lower individual-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于Shapley值的分析师特定衡量方法，用于识别那些个人预测能为总体共识预测增加更多增量价值的卖方分析师。研究发现，具有较大绝对预测误差和较大共识偏离的逆向分析师对共识准确性有更大的增量影响。
AI.research_question: 哪些卖方分析师的个人预测能为总体共识预测增加更多增量价值？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注分析师个人预测的准确性，但较少研究分析师对总体共识预测的增量贡献。理解哪些分析师能为共识预测增加价值对于投资者和市场参与者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Shapley值理论（合作博弈理论），信息聚合理论，分析师行为理论
AI.method: 开发基于Shapley值的分析师特定衡量方法，通过汇总分析师在其覆盖公司投资组合中对共识准确性的边际贡献来计算价值增值指标
AI.findings:
1. 逆向分析师（具有较大绝对预测误差和较大共识偏离）对共识准确性有更大的增量影响
2. 全明星分析师和大型券商的分析师在总体层面增加的增量价值较低
3. 预测时机（非常及时或较晚）和工作经验也对预测偏离和价值增值有积极影响
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将Shapley值理论应用于分析师预测评估，提供了新的方法论框架
2. 挑战了传统上仅关注个人预测准确性的评估方式
3. 揭示了逆向分析师在信息聚合中的重要作用，尽管他们个人预测准确性较低
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供了识别真正能为共识预测增加价值分析师的工具
2. 帮助市场参与者更好地理解分析师预测的集体价值
3. 为券商和分析师评估提供了新的视角，超越传统的准确性指标

title: Key Economic Number as an Indicator of Innovative Development
affiliations: The Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Key Economic Number as an Indicator of Innovative Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The datasets used and/or analyzed during this study are available from the author upon reasonable request.

keywords: Domestic Lending to the Private Sector

detail.abstract: The paper presents an analysis of economic indicators characterizing innovative development and technology transfer from science to business. This analysis is aimed at identification and substantiation of the conditions and key indicators necessary for innovative scientific and technological progress. A statistical analysis of innovation development indicators was carried out for 48 countries with the largest GDPs. For these countries, innovation development indicators necessary for intensive technology transfer were identified and substantiated. Three key indicators were selected from this set: R&D expenditures, machine tool production, and domestic lending to the private sector as a percentage of GDP. The importance of the above indicators was tested using data from eight countries, five of which had the highest GDPs in 2021 (the United States, China, Japan, Germany, and India). Russia, South Korea, and Argentina were chosen as countries that demonstrated accelerated or decelerated economic growth over a given period compared to the global average. As a result, the so-called "key economic number" (KEN) was proposed; this number characterizes the innovative development of economy. This number is determined by three key factors: research and development expenditures, machine tool production, and domestic lending to the private sector as a share of GDP.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过统计分析48个最大GDP国家的创新指标，识别出影响技术转移的三个关键指标：研发支出、机床生产和私人部门国内信贷占GDP比重，并提出了一个综合这些指标的"关键经济数字"来衡量经济创新发展。
AI.research_question: 哪些经济指标最能表征创新发展和技术从科学向商业转移？如何构建一个综合指标来有效衡量经济的创新发展水平？
AI.motivation: 需要识别和验证促进创新发展和科学到商业技术转移的关键条件与指标，为政策制定和经济发展提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新经济学和技术转移理论，关注研发投入、生产能力（机床生产）和金融支持（私人信贷）三个维度的相互作用。
AI.method: 对48个最大GDP国家进行创新指标的统计分析，识别关键指标，然后选取8个代表性国家（包括5个最大GDP国家和3个经济增长异常国家）进行验证。
AI.findings: 确定了三个关键创新指标：研发支出、机床生产和私人部门国内信贷占GDP比重。基于这些指标提出了"关键经济数字"（KEN）作为衡量经济创新发展的综合指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含研发、生产和金融三个维度的综合创新衡量框架，丰富了创新经济学和技术转移理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的可操作指标来评估和促进创新发展，KEN指标可用于跨国比较和国内政策评估。

title: On the Issue of Legal Regulation of Gambling Simulation in Game Content
affiliations: and Uzhhorod National University

detail.title: On the Issue of Legal Regulation of Gambling Simulation in Game Content
detail.abstract:
This article explores the need to regulate microtransactions in video games that may simulate gambling in-game content. The convergence of gambling and digital games is examined, particularly through the example of loot boxes as random items purchased for real money. Gambling is considered here as requiring state regulation, and its presence in video games without age restrictions may become a dangerous practice for consumers and encourage further involvement in such gambling in the future. In addition, virtual environments managed by technology companies may engage in exploitative policies towards users, encouraging addictive behaviour and selling in-game content in a deceptive manner through incomplete disclosure of information about possible winnings.
             The need for increased state attention to this area, which is causing increasing public resonance, is analysed. Thus, this work examined completely different models of regulation: European and Asian. The first of them, at the level of the European Union, leaves this issue to the consideration of the member states. For example, countries such as the United Kingdom and France have not yet assumed responsibility for state regulation of microtransactions in video games, and Belgium and the Netherlands have recognised loot boxes as gambling. The second is Asian countries, in particular China, South Korea, and Japan, which have taken control of this area, which turned out to be a fairly effective method and helped protect the interests of their own citizens and consumers of gaming content. The third model proposed by scientists is self-regulation of this industry, which can become really effective after some subordination of this sphere to state regulation, since the giants of the gaming industry can take responsibility for changing the rules for microtransactions in favor of consumers either in the presence of significant competition in the market, or under the influence of state coercion (as in the example of Asian countries).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了视频游戏中模拟赌博的微交易（如开箱）需要监管的必要性，分析了赌博与数字游戏的融合，比较了欧洲和亚洲的不同监管模式，并提出了行业自我监管的可能性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效监管视频游戏中模拟赌博的微交易（特别是开箱机制），以保护消费者利益并防止赌博行为蔓延？
AI.motivation: 视频游戏中模拟赌博的微交易（如开箱）缺乏年龄限制和监管，可能对消费者构成危险，鼓励未来参与赌博行为，且科技公司可能通过不完整信息披露进行剥削性营销。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赌博监管理论、消费者保护理论、数字游戏经济学、行为成瘾理论、信息披露与透明度理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比欧洲（欧盟、英国、法国、比利时、荷兰）和亚洲（中国、韩国、日本）的不同监管模式；政策分析；案例研究（开箱机制）。
AI.findings: 1. 欧洲模式：欧盟层面将监管权下放给成员国，导致监管碎片化（比利时、荷兰认定开箱为赌博，英法则未监管）。2. 亚洲模式：中国、韩国、日本实施主动监管，有效保护消费者利益。3. 行业自我监管在政府监管框架下可能有效，但需要市场竞争或政府强制力推动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了视频游戏微交易监管的三模式理论框架（欧洲分散模式、亚洲集中模式、行业自我监管模式），丰富了数字游戏监管和消费者保护理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的监管模式参考，建议借鉴亚洲国家的有效监管经验；为游戏行业提供了自我监管的路径建议；为消费者权益保护提供了实践指导。

title: Understanding Reciprocal Tariffs
affiliations: University of San Francisco

detail.title: Understanding Reciprocal Tariffs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: On April 2, 2025, the Trump administration published a series of reciprocal tariffs that would be applied to foreign countries across the globe. This document attempts to understand the calculation and philosophical methodology that created those reciprocal tariffs. This document assumes that the administration would like to issue reciprocal tariffs and proposes an alternative measure of reciprocal tariffs that is still simple, yet might be more reasonable by taking account of existing total trade barriers. This method borrows concepts from the international trade gravity literature to compute reciprocal tariffs, while still maintaining the original spirit of the Trump reciprocal tariffs.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了特朗普政府于2025年4月2日发布的全球互惠关税，探讨其计算方法和哲学基础，并提出一种考虑现有总贸易壁垒的替代性互惠关税计算方法。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府互惠关税的计算方法和哲学基础是什么？如何设计一种既简单又更合理的替代性互惠关税计算方法？
AI.motivation: 理解特朗普政府互惠关税政策的制定逻辑，并提出改进方案，使其在保持简单性的同时更加合理，考虑现有贸易壁垒的影响。

AI.method: 借鉴国际贸易引力文献概念，计算互惠关税，同时保持特朗普互惠关税的原始精神。
AI.findings: 提出了基于现有总贸易壁垒的替代性互惠关税计算方法，该方法更合理但仍保持简单性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国际贸易引力模型应用于互惠关税计算，为贸易政策分析提供新的理论框架。

title: The Welfare Implications of the China Shock across U.S. States and Skill Groups

detail.title: The Welfare Implications of the China Shock across U.S. States and Skill Groups

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: I build a dynamic quantitative spatial trade model with firm and worker heterogeneity, mobility frictions, and short-run unemployment to quantify the regional and distributional effects of the China Shock across U.S. states. The baseline model implies an average welfare gain (0.1%) but substantial heterogeneity across skill groups. Average welfare gains are 0.01% for unskilled workers —who lose in 17 of 50 states—versus 0.31% for skilled workers, who lose in only 7 states. The model predicts an average increase of 0.78% in the skill premium, with more exposed states experiencing larger increases. Finally, I find long-run gains in every state for both types of workers.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含企业和工人异质性、流动摩擦和短期失业的动态定量空间贸易模型，量化了中国冲击对美国各州的区域和分配效应。基准模型显示平均福利增益为0.1%，但不同技能群体间存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 中国冲击对美国各州的区域和分配效应是什么？不同技能群体的福利变化如何？
AI.motivation: 理解全球化冲击（特别是中国崛起）对美国劳动力市场的异质性影响，特别是区域差异和技能群体间的分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态定量空间贸易理论，包含企业和工人异质性、劳动力流动摩擦、短期失业机制。
AI.method: 构建动态定量空间贸易模型，包含企业和工人异质性、流动摩擦和短期失业，通过模型量化分析中国冲击的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 平均福利增益0.1%，但技能群体差异显著：非熟练工人平均增益0.01%（50个州中有17个州受损），熟练工人平均增益0.31%（仅7个州受损）。2. 技能溢价平均增加0.78%，受冲击更大的州增加更多。3. 长期来看，所有州的两类工人都能获得收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了包含异质性、流动摩擦和短期失业的动态空间贸易模型。2. 为全球化冲击的区域和分配效应提供了新的理论框架。3. 揭示了短期和长期效应的差异机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了中国冲击对美国各州影响的量化评估。2. 揭示了技能群体间的分配不平等问题。3. 为区域发展和劳动力市场政策提供了实证依据。

title: Pledging in Capital Markets
affiliations: O P Jindal University

detail.title: Pledging in Capital Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No [ersonal or monetary interest to influence the study.

detail.abstract: Pledging of shares is a quick money to raise money and is adopted by a diaspora of investors at different levels of hierarchy, from individual investors to promoters. This method is adopted globally in different jurisdictions such as and is considered efficient to aid in financial distress situation. The practice is prevalent in India. It is guided by India Contract Act, 1872. It has its own merits and demerits. The stakeholder should use this practice responsibly because the risks associated with it not only increase personal leverage but affect other shareholders of the company and share market as whole. To prevent and mitigate risks the Securities Exchange Board of India furnished strict guidelines which are amended to close loopholes and ensure transparency. rom a legal perspective, the Indian judiciary has set precedents to clarify the rights and duties of parties involved as well the punishment for fraudulent activities relating to it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度股票质押实践，分析了其作为快速融资方式的优势与风险，并研究了监管框架和司法判例对风险防控的作用。
AI.research_question: 股票质押在印度如何作为一种融资工具运作？其相关的风险是什么？监管框架和司法判例如何帮助预防和减轻这些风险？
AI.motivation: 股票质押在印度被广泛采用，从个人投资者到公司发起人都在使用这种快速融资方式。虽然它在财务困境中很有效，但相关风险不仅增加个人杠杆，还影响公司其他股东和整个股票市场。因此需要研究如何负责任地使用这种实践，以及监管和司法如何防控风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度合同法（1872年）的法律框架，结合证券监管理论和公司治理理论，分析股票质押的权利义务关系、风险传导机制和市场影响。
AI.method: 采用法律文本分析、监管政策研究和司法判例分析的方法，结合实践案例探讨股票质押的运作机制和风险防控。
AI.findings: 1. 股票质押是印度普遍采用的快速融资方式，具有效率优势；2. 该实践存在显著风险，包括个人杠杆增加和对其他股东及市场的负面影响；3. 印度证券交易委员会制定了严格指南并不断修订以堵塞漏洞；4. 印度司法系统通过判例明确了各方权利义务和欺诈行为的惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了发展中国家股票质押实践的理论研究；2. 提供了法律监管与市场实践互动的分析框架；3. 贡献了关于新兴市场金融工具风险管理的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了股票质押风险识别的实用指南；2. 为监管机构提供了政策制定的参考依据；3. 为司法实践提供了权利义务界定的判例参考；4. 促进了印度股票质押市场的透明度和规范性。

title: Correlation and Commodity Risk Premia
affiliations: Griffith University - Department of Accounting, Finance and Economics and Curtin University

detail.title: Correlation and Commodity Risk Premia
detail.abstract: We document a novel correlation premium in commodity futures. A long-short correlation portfolio delivers positive average returns but is largely spanned by exposures to the aggregate market, hedging pressure, and skewness factors. The correlation premium reflects compensation to liquidity providers for absorbing hedger-driven market impact in illiquid markets, as high comovement signals market-wide flows and hedging pressure that amplify systematic risk. Factor performance is state-dependent, with momentum underperforming in high-comovement and high-volatility regimes while hedging pressure strengthens. Overall, our findings explain the absence of commodity low-volatility premia, clarify why volatility-managed factors often fail, and establish average correlation as a conditioning variable for cross-sectional and conditional commodity returns.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现商品期货中存在一种新的相关性溢价。相关性投资组合能产生正收益，但主要被市场、对冲压力和偏度因子所解释。这种溢价反映了流动性提供者为吸收对冲者驱动的市场影响而获得的补偿，高相关性信号表明市场范围内的流动性和对冲压力放大了系统性风险。因子表现具有状态依赖性，动量因子在高相关性和高波动率环境下表现不佳，而对冲压力因子则增强。
AI.research_question: 商品期货中是否存在相关性溢价？这种溢价如何被现有因子解释？相关性溢价背后的经济机制是什么？相关性如何影响商品因子的条件表现？
AI.motivation: 解释商品市场中低波动率溢价的缺失，阐明波动率管理因子经常失效的原因，建立平均相关性作为商品横截面和条件收益的调节变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性提供者补偿理论（对冲者驱动的市场影响）、系统性风险放大机制（高相关性信号市场流动性和对冲压力）、因子状态依赖理论
AI.method: 构建商品期货的长短相关性投资组合，分析其收益特征，检验其与市场、对冲压力、偏度等因子的关系，研究相关性在不同市场状态下的调节作用
AI.findings: 1. 存在显著的商品相关性溢价；2. 相关性溢价主要被市场、对冲压力和偏度因子所解释；3. 溢价反映了流动性提供者吸收对冲者驱动市场影响的补偿；4. 因子表现具有状态依赖性：动量在高相关性和高波动率环境下表现不佳，对冲压力增强；5. 平均相关性可作为商品收益的有效调节变量
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在商品期货中识别相关性溢价；2. 建立了相关性溢价的经济机制理论（流动性提供者补偿）；3. 解释了商品低波动率溢价缺失的原因；4. 阐明了波动率管理因子失效的机制；5. 发展了因子状态依赖理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为商品投资策略提供新的因子（相关性）；2. 指导投资者在不同相关性环境下调整因子配置；3. 帮助理解商品市场的系统性风险传导机制；4. 为风险管理提供新的调节变量；5. 为流动性提供者定价提供理论依据

title: Arbitrator Differentiation and Competition under the No Surprises Act

detail.title: Arbitrator Differentiation and Competition under the No Surprises Act
detail.abstract: Arbitration presents a cheap and fast option for resolving health care payment disputes, but it is unclear how individual arbitrators affect resolution outcomes. This paper estimates arbitrator effects on payment determinations made in a clearinghouse for dispute resolution where parties jointly choose an arbitrator to decide their case. Giving disputing parties choice over their arbitrator can be beneficial if parties are better informed about their dispute and the set of arbitrators than a planner, but competition among arbitrators to be chosen may distort their decisions. The No Surprises Act, a 2022 law enacted in the United States, established a centralized platform for disputing health care providers and insurers to select an arbitrator to resolve their disagreement. Among 7 arbitrators, the highest-and lowest-awarding differ by 21% (on a mean of $1,379) in their payment awards to physicians for observably identical cases. This paper finds that the No Surprises Act's arbitration platform established a market for arbitrators; arbitrators compete on payment generosity to physicians, leading to different allocations between physicians and insurers for the same health care visit.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现美国《无意外法案》仲裁平台建立了仲裁员市场，仲裁员通过支付慷慨度竞争案件，导致相同医疗案例中医生和保险公司之间的分配差异高达21%。
AI.research_question: 仲裁员选择如何影响医疗支付争议的解决结果？仲裁员之间的竞争如何影响其裁决决策？
AI.motivation: 仲裁作为解决医疗支付争议的廉价快速方式，但个体仲裁员对结果的影响尚不明确。2022年美国《无意外法案》建立了集中仲裁平台，为研究仲裁员选择和竞争效应提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仲裁员选择理论：当事人选择仲裁员可能比规划者更了解争议和仲裁员信息；仲裁员竞争理论：仲裁员为被选择而竞争可能扭曲其决策。
AI.method: 利用《无意外法案》建立的争议解决清算所数据，分析7名仲裁员对观察上相同案例的支付裁决差异，估计仲裁员效应。
AI.findings: 在7名仲裁员中，最高和最低支付裁决相差21%（平均1379美元），仲裁员通过支付慷慨度竞争案件，导致相同医疗访问中医生和保险公司之间的分配差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了仲裁员个体效应对争议解决结果的影响；2. 揭示了仲裁员市场竞争如何扭曲裁决决策；3. 为仲裁机制设计提供了理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供仲裁平台设计的实证依据；2. 帮助争议当事人理解仲裁员选择的重要性；3. 为医疗支付争议解决机制改革提供参考。

title: Financial Decision Making in the Age of AI
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: Financial Decision Making in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: This article gives perspective on the academic literature on personal financial decision making. I explore three main domains of financial choices: savings versus consumption, investment decision making, and choices around debt. In each domain, people behave in ways that deviate from normative prescriptions of financial economics. I explore the main drivers of financial decisions that result in these deviations. The article concludes with a forward-looking perspective of how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) might reshape the landscape of individual's financial decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了个人财务决策的学术文献，探讨了储蓄与消费、投资决策、债务选择三个领域中的行为偏差，分析了导致这些偏差的主要驱动因素，并展望了生成式人工智能如何重塑个人财务决策格局。
AI.research_question: 个人在储蓄与消费、投资决策、债务选择三个财务决策领域中，为何会偏离财务经济学的规范性建议？这些行为偏差的主要驱动因素是什么？生成式人工智能将如何影响个人财务决策？
AI.motivation: 个人财务决策对经济福祉至关重要，但现实中人们的行为常常偏离理性经济模型。理解这些偏差的根源对于改善财务决策、政策制定和金融教育具有重要意义。随着生成式人工智能的发展，需要前瞻性地思考技术如何改变财务决策环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、心理账户理论、有限理性理论、双系统思维模型（系统1和系统2）、前景理论、时间不一致偏好、社会比较理论等。
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统梳理和分析个人财务决策三个主要领域（储蓄与消费、投资决策、债务选择）的现有学术研究，识别行为偏差模式并分析其驱动因素。
AI.findings: 1. 储蓄与消费领域：存在过度消费、储蓄不足、心理账户偏差等现象；2. 投资决策领域：存在处置效应、过度自信、羊群效应、损失厌恶等偏差；3. 债务选择领域：存在信用卡债务累积、高息借款、债务管理不善等问题。这些偏差主要受认知局限、情绪影响、社会因素和制度环境驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统整合了个人财务决策三个关键领域的偏差研究；2. 识别了跨领域的行为偏差共同驱动因素；3. 为行为金融学在个人财务决策中的应用提供了综合框架；4. 提出了生成式人工智能影响财务决策的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融教育提供实证基础；2. 为金融机构设计更符合用户行为的金融产品提供参考；3. 为政策制定者设计行为干预措施提供依据；4. 为金融科技公司开发基于生成式人工智能的财务决策工具提供方向。

title: Inflation Expectations, Investment, and the Mundell-Tobin Financing Channel
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Inflation Expectations, Investment, and the Mundell-Tobin Financing Channel
detail.abstract: Using a randomized information experiment on Italian firms, we show that the investment response to inflation expectations depends systematically on the horizon of those expectations and on the pledgeability of capital. The tangible investment semi-elasticity with respect to expected inflation nearly doubles as the forecast horizon extends from six months to five years, and is roughly four times larger than the corresponding intangible response. These joint facts are difficult to reconcile with standard valuation or money illusion mechanisms but are consistent with a Mundell-Tobin financing channel in which firms lock in long-term nominal borrowing to fund tangible assets.

AI.tldr: 通过意大利企业的随机信息实验发现，通胀预期对投资的影响取决于预期时间跨度和资本可抵押性。长期通胀预期对有形投资的半弹性是短期的近两倍，且是有形投资对无形投资影响的四倍。这些发现支持Mundell-Tobin融资渠道理论，即企业通过长期名义借款为有形资产融资。
AI.research_question: 通胀预期的时间跨度如何影响企业投资决策？有形资产和无形资产的投资对通胀预期的反应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀预期如何影响企业投资对货币政策传导机制至关重要。现有研究主要关注短期通胀预期，但长期通胀预期的影响机制尚不明确，特别是对于不同类型资产的投资反应差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mundell-Tobin融资渠道理论：企业通过长期名义借款锁定低利率，为有形资产融资。标准估值理论、货币幻觉理论。
AI.method: 在意大利企业中进行随机信息实验，通过控制通胀预期信息，观察不同时间跨度（6个月vs5年）通胀预期对投资的影响，比较有形资产和无形资产的投资反应。
AI.findings: 1. 通胀预期对有形投资的半弹性随预期时间跨度延长而增加（5年期是6个月期的近两倍）；2. 有形投资对通胀预期的反应大约是无形投资的四倍；3. 这些发现难以用标准估值或货币幻觉理论解释，但符合Mundell-Tobin融资渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为Mundell-Tobin融资渠道提供了实证支持；2. 揭示了通胀预期时间维度的重要性；3. 区分了不同类型资产对通胀预期的异质性反应；4. 挑战了传统估值理论和货币幻觉理论的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策制定者提供了通胀预期管理的新视角；2. 帮助企业理解通胀预期对投资决策的影响机制；3. 为金融机构评估企业融资行为提供参考；4. 强调了长期通胀预期管理的重要性。

title: Case Comment: PTC India Financial Ltd. vs. Venkatleswar Kari & Anr., Civil Appeal no. 5443 of 2019
affiliations: O P Jindal University

detail.title: Case Comment: PTC India Financial Ltd. vs. Venkatleswar Kari & Anr., Civil Appeal no. 5443 of 2019
